# Image { #anylumino.Image }

```python
Image(
    value=b'',
    format='png',
    width='',
    height='',
    layout=None,
)
```

Image display widget.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type     | Description                                              | Default    |
|--------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `b''` |
| format | optional | Media format such as ``'png'``, ``'mp3'``, or ``'mp4'``. | `'png'` |
| width | optional | CSS width for media widgets. | `''` |
| height | optional | CSS height for media widgets. | `''` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [format](#anylumino.Image.format) | The format of the image. |
| [height](#anylumino.Image.height) | Height of the image in pixels. Use layout.height for styling the widget. |
| [width](#anylumino.Image.width) | Width of the image in pixels. Use layout.width for styling the widget. |
